title: StandardAero Enhances Business Jet Paint Services at Springfield, IL Aircraft Service Center
summary: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. – October 21, 2026 – StandardAero (NYSE: SARO), a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), and engine component repair today announced the completion of significant upgrades to the paint hangar facilities at its aircraft service center at Abraham Lincoln Airport (SPI) in Springfield, […]
body_markdown:
**SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. – October 21** **, 2026 –** ****[StandardAero](https://standardaero.com/) (NYSE: SARO), a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), and engine component repair today announced the completion of significant upgrades to the paint hangar facilities at its aircraft service center at Abraham Lincoln Airport (SPI) in Springfield, IL. In addition to enhancing paint services for business aviation operators, StandardAero is expanding its paint technician workforce at the facility, leading to improved turnaround times for customers.


StandardAero provides CompleteCare™ support for business jet operators, as a one-stop shop for heavy aircraft maintenance, Gogo and Starlink Wi-Fi installations, refurbishment and engine services. The company offers standard and custom upgrade paint design and application services for Bombardier Challenger and Global, Dassault Falcon, and Gulfstream aircraft.


“StandardAero Springfield’s reputation for world-class business aircraft paint services is well-known, and the completion of this project ensures customers can enjoy the highest level of paint service quality for decades to come,” said David Pearman, Vice President and General Manager of StandardAero Springfield.


The Springfield aircraft service center, specializing in aircraft modification services for more than 30 years, features a dedicated 62,000 sq ft paint hangar established in 1998. It recently reopened its paint shop after critical upgrades, including air-handling, pressurization, and filtration system replacements.


“Our team applies hand-painting techniques to custom designs, and rather than buffing out paint imperfections, we choose to sand and repaint for the best final product,” Pearman said. “It’s the precision workmanship that sets StandardAero Springfield apart and keeps customers returning for their painting needs.”


The Springfield site is currently[hiring paint technicians](https://cva.fa.us1.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_3/jobs?keyword=+paint&location=Springfield%2C+IL%2C+United+States&locationId=300000002059227&locationLevel=city&mode=location&radius=25&radiusUnit=MI) to join its paint shop team. To learn more about the[StandardAero Springfield facility’s](https://standardaero.com/aboutus/locations/springfield-il26/) comprehensive aircraft MRO services or speak to a recruiter about career opportunities, StandardAero is exhibiting at NBAA-BACE in the Las Vegas Convention Center’s West Hall at[booth #1745](https://nbaa26.mapyourshow.com/8_0/floorplan/?selectedBooth=booth%7E1745&hallID=A&level=1) during exhibition hours October 20 – 22, 2026. Please visit the booth for more information.


###


**StandardAero** is a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services for fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft, serving the commercial, military and business aviation end markets. StandardAero provides a comprehensive suite of critical, value-added aftermarket solutions, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul, engine component repair, on-wing and field service support, asset management and engineering solutions. StandardAero is an NYSE-listed company under the ticker symbol SARO.
